items.title: Charge ki quantization (q = Ne) aur electrostatics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Chapter 9 opening (PDF 192-193).

blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke electron par charge ki miqdar (magnitude) proton ke charge ke barabar hoti hai. Proton par charge e⁺ aur electron par e⁻ hota hai. Is ki qeemat e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C hai; C (coulomb) charge ki SI unit hai. Yeh charge (e) ab tak mila sab se chhota azaad (free) charge hai. Kisi cheez par bara charge electrons dal kar (add) ya nikal kar (remove) banta hai. Kisi bhi particle par kam se kam itna charge ho sakta hai. Is liye har charge q, e ka poora guna (integer multiple) hota hai:

blocks.latex: q = Ne \qquad \text{jahan N poora adad (integer) hai}
blocks.text_alt: q = Ne    jahan N poora adad (integer) hai

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Charge tukron mein aata hai: e, 2e, 3e ... Aadha e (0.5e) ya 1.5e kabhi nahi milta. Isay charge ki quantization kehte hain. Misal: 3 electrons nikalne se jism par +3e = 4.8 × 10⁻¹⁹ C charge aata hai.

Electrostatics un charges ki study hai jo ruke hue (at rest) hon: un ke mazahir (phenomena) aur khasiyat (properties). Jab charges chalne lagein (motion mein hon) to is behaao ko electric current kehte hain.

blocks.title: Charles de Coulomb (1736-1806)
blocks.text: Coulomb ka science mein sab se bara kaam electrostatics aur magnetism mein tha. Unhon ne materials ki mazbooti (strength) bhi jaanchi aur beams (shehteer) par lagne wali forces maloom kin; is tarah structural mechanics mein hissa dala. Ergonomics (kaam ko insaan ke liye aasaan banane ka ilm) mein un ki research ne bataya ke insaan aur janwar kaam sab se behtar tareeqe se kaise kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya kisi particle par 2.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ C ya 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C charge ho sakta hai (MCQ 9.2)? 100 A h (ampere-hour) wali battery kitna charge de sakti hai (short question 9.3)?
blocks.explanation: Charge hamesha e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C ka poora guna hota hai. 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 2e, yeh mumkin hai (option b). 2.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 1.56e, poora adad nahi, is liye mumkin nahi. 100 A h battery ek ghante (3600 s) tak 100 A de sakti hai: Q = It = 100 A × 3600 s = 3.6 × 10⁵ C.

items: e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C sab se chhota azaad charge hai; jism electrons dal kar ya nikal kar charged hote hain.
q = Ne, N poora adad: charge ki quantization.
Electrostatics: ruke hue charges; chalte charges electric current banate hain.
